method: Exact unscaled Pillow crop and paste only; 192 px each side for joins, 256 px each quadrant for crossings; no source pixel editing or resampling. All 9 native originals were viewed for source context, the 4 selected row1 originals were independently assessed, and all 24 report crop evidence images were visually reviewed. Source and metadata hashes were reverified unchanged at completion.
